'''Neet Alamant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a recruiter for [[Civilian Adjunct to the Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Alamant recruited [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Memah Roothes]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] as part of a drive to acquire personnel for the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] complement. He offered her the position of bartender at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the station.
